Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Latin word

nōs

nōs, nōbīs (reflexive)

pronoun: the ordinary forms of nōs, used reflexively

ourselves (as object); we, us

In this lexicon

  • ourselves

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Att. 1.6.2: ut nōbīsmet ipsīs … placeāmus

  • we

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fam. 14.14.1: sī vōs valētis, nōs valēmus; Petr. 75.1: nēmō nostrum nōn peccat

Examples

  • nōs Tusculānō ita dēlectāmur ut nōbīsmet ipsīs tum dēnique cum illō vēnimus placeāmus

    We love Tusculum so much that we are only pleased with ourselves when we have got there.Cic. Att. 1.6.2
